# HTTP 402 AI Tollbooth

> A multi-rail HTTP 402 marketplace offering 203 machine-readable developer troubleshooting datasets across DevOps, APIs, ML/AI, Web/Frontend, and Databases.

## Discovery
- Catalog: https://http-402-ai-tollbooth.rsaun-lightning.workers.dev/api/catalog
- Categories: https://http-402-ai-tollbooth.rsaun-lightning.workers.dev/api/categories
- Free preview: https://http-402-ai-tollbooth.rsaun-lightning.workers.dev/api/preview/{product}
- Payment methods: https://http-402-ai-tollbooth.rsaun-lightning.workers.dev/api/payment-methods
- MCP endpoint: https://http-402-ai-tollbooth.rsaun-lightning.workers.dev/mcp
- MCP manifest: https://http-402-ai-tollbooth.rsaun-lightning.workers.dev/.well-known/mcp.json
- OpenAPI 3.1: https://http-402-ai-tollbooth.rsaun-lightning.workers.dev/openapi.json
- Payment guide: https://http-402-ai-tollbooth.rsaun-lightning.workers.dev/docs/payment-flow
- Contact: https://http-402-ai-tollbooth.rsaun-lightning.workers.dev/contact

## Payment methods
- Bitcoin Lightning — mainnet BOLT11 invoice flow.
- x402 USDC on Solana — x402 v2 exact challenge when enabled.
- Stripe Checkout — hosted USD checkout with server-side paid-session verification.

## Payment model
Call /api/payment-methods first. Do not assume /api/data is Lightning-only: the machine route is fronted by x402 when enabled. Lightning remains available through /web/buy/{product}; Stripe Checkout through /web/stripe/buy/{product}.

## Record contract
Every paid record contains non-empty error_code, description, and programmatic_fix strings. Free previews return exactly three records and never require payment.
